name: Curve DEX
description: Curve is a decentralized exchange liquidity pool on Ethereum designed for extremely efficient stablecoin trading

methodology.UserFees: Swap and liquidity fees paid by traders. Excludes bribes, which are paid by third parties bidding for gauge votes, not by users.
methodology.Fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools, plus bribes paid to veCRV voters. Fee rates are set per pool - around 0.01%-0.04% on stable pools and up to a few percent on volatile pools.
methodology.Revenue: The share of pool fees kept by the protocol rather than paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee - plus bribes.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 10% of the protocol's share of pool fees, sent to the Curve DAO treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 90% of the protocol's share of pool fees, distributed to veCRV holders, plus all bribes.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of pool fees paid to liquidity providers - usually half of the fee.

Fees.CurveDEX Swap Fees: Swap and liquidity fees charged by Curve pools

Revenue.CurveDEX Admin Fees: Fees distributed to veCRV holders and protocol treasury

ProtocolRevenue.CurveDEX Admin Fees To Treasury: Fees allocated to the protocol treasury

HoldersRevenue.CurveDEX Fees To veCRV Holders: Fees distributed to veCRV governance token holders
